newsitem.title: USA: Dravo sees Q1 net off significantly due to floods.
newsitem.headline: Dravo sees Q1 net off significantly due to floods.

text.p: Dravo Corp on Wednesday said first quarter results will likely be "significantly lower than a year ago" due to current flood conditions near its two lime plants in northern Kentucky which are disrupting delivery schedules to power plant customers.

"While this week's developments are sure to have a negative effect on our company's earnings, we won't be able to assess their full impact until flood conditions subside and the barge companies are able to resume normal service," said Dravo president and chief executive officer Carl Gilbert.

"With shipments for the first two months of the year lower than anticipated, however, this current situation is likely to result in a level of quarterly performance significantly lower than that of a year ago."
"The flood waters pose no danger to our plants, but flooding conditions have made it virtually impossible to maintain our normal barge loading schedule," Gilbert said.
